missing_evidence: Order service logs or DB pool metrics showing wait/queue growth over time
Confirmation of pool size and saturation cause (slow queries vs. connection leak)
candidates.statement: Order service shows 36 db_pool_waiters with p95 latency of 1300 ms while gateway and payment remain at 71 ms and near-zero error rate, indicating database connection pool saturation in order is driving the checkout latency alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Error rate is low (0.0012) across services, so the alert's error-rate component is not yet explained by this evidence.

report.explanation: Order service is the only component with elevated latency (p95 1300 ms) and 36 db_pool_waiters, while gateway and payment are healthy at 71 ms with no dependency timeouts. This supports db-pool-exhaustion in order as the bounded root-cause candidate; error-rate elevation is not corroborated by current telemetry.
